name: Eli
source:
The daughter of an aristocratic family hailing from a country that was absorbed during the unification of Germany.
She is currently enrolled in the Reserve Officers' Training corps, and she hopes to one day attend the Army Academy.
Assertive and unrestrained, she has no romantic experience whatsoever.
